description: Morphe Patches 1.11.0. Includes two independently selectable Suno patches: timestamped-lyrics export (LRC, enhanced LRC, SRT, WebVTT, JSON) and app branding with custom name/icon options; the Opera GX 56-icon launcher selector; the independently selectable Opera GX raw mod downloader; and the Chrome 150 MonkeyScript manager with contrast-safe Material You, page-capable userscript execution, Greasy Fork/Sleazy Fork installation, and publishing.
